comment: Independent zap.c dobuzz() hero-square arm for a rider. A debug-mode Knight mounts the adjacent south pony (forced), raises experience level to 14, wishes for a wand of lightning and zaps it east into the nearby wall twice. The first bounce picks the steed (rn2(3) == 0) and kills it through C's goto buzzmonst, which skips the hero arm's flashburn() and stop_occupation(). The second bounce, with no steed left, hits the hero.
